name: tool-ledger-01
title: Tool Ledger 01 - The Tool Calls Of A Run
description: The tool-call ledger of a run in flight, receiving calls as they arrive over a subscription the consumer supplies. The second live surface, and the one beside the event log: it says what was called and what it cost in structure rather than in words. Prism owns the rows, the five states and the window; the consumer owns the socket, the transport, the durations and the persistence. Every string is passed in as a prop.
